actions.title: Prioritize clinical conversation sources
actions.description:
Clinical reasoning accuracy is below 85%; prioritize high-quality clinical sources and add targeted source selection.

Trigger: clinical_reasoning_accuracy=60.00 (lt 85.0)
SOP: Adjust source queue weighting to double-source clinical channels, then run a 2-cycle pilot before broad rollout.
Expected Impact: Increase clinical reasoning coverage and reduce clinical failures by 10-20% in next validation batch
Evidence: {'metric': 'clinical_reasoning_accuracy', 'measured_value': 60.00000000000001, 'threshold': 85.0, 'operator': 'lt', 'notes': '[medium] Model fails to recall relevant memories in context (freq=0.30); upstream(acquisition, conf=0.66): Source data lacks high-quality memory-context pairs; intervention[acquisition](medium): Adjust source data priorities → Improve memory_recall_recall by 10-20%; intervention[acquisition](medium): Update quality thresholds → Improve memory_recall_recall by 10-20%; intervention[acquisition](low): Adjust source data priorities → Improve generation_quality by 10-20%; intervention[acquisition](low): Update quality thresholds → Improve generation_quality by 10-20%'}

Execution checklist:
- Raise acquisition priority for sources with clinical-therapy tags
- Route source selection to increase clinical reasoning coverage by +20%
- Add review gate requiring clinical rationale validation before merge

actions.title: Tighten curation filters for clinical rationale
actions.description:
Clinical reasoning is degrading; adjust curation rules to catch weak rationale before training ingestion.

Trigger: clinical_reasoning_accuracy=60.00 (lt 92.0)
SOP: Apply rule changes to 50% of incoming clinical batches for two days, then compare post-curation gap metrics.
Expected Impact: Improve signal quality of clinical content and stabilize reasoning pass rates
Evidence: {'metric': 'clinical_reasoning_accuracy', 'measured_value': 60.00000000000001, 'threshold': 92.0, 'operator': 'lt', 'notes': '[medium] Model fails to recall relevant memories in context (freq=0.30); upstream(acquisition, conf=0.66): Source data lacks high-quality memory-context pairs; intervention[acquisition](medium): Adjust source data priorities → Improve memory_recall_recall by 10-20%; intervention[acquisition](medium): Update quality thresholds → Improve memory_recall_recall by 10-20%; intervention[acquisition](low): Adjust source data priorities → Improve generation_quality by 10-20%; intervention[acquisition](low): Update quality thresholds → Improve generation_quality by 10-20%'}

Execution checklist:
- Introduce curation rule: require clear intervention/plan structure
- Add minimum clinical anchor requirement (grounded recommendation or safety signpost)
- Increase curator sampling rate for borderline clinical responses

actions.title: Shift dataset weighting toward empathetic style coverage
actions.description:
Empathy score below threshold indicates low emotional attunement in curated samples.

Trigger: empathy_score=71.67 (lt 75.0)
SOP: Run a curation rule A/B test for 3k records and compare empathy pass rates before full rollout.
Expected Impact: Increase emotional alignment and reduce low-empathy failure clusters
Evidence: {'metric': 'empathy_score', 'measured_value': 71.66666666666667, 'threshold': 75.0, 'operator': 'lt', 'notes': '[medium] Generated responses drift from conversation context (freq=0.13); upstream(curation, conf=0.63): Context normalization insufficient or misaligned; intervention[curation](low): Update curation rules → Improve memory_recall_precision by 10-20%; intervention[curation](low): Add dataset filter → Improve memory_recall_precision by 10-20%; intervention[curation](medium): Update curation rules → Improve context_relevance by 10-20%; intervention[curation](medium): Add dataset filter → Improve context_relevance by 10-20%'}

Execution checklist:
- Add empathetic response pattern checks to pre-ingestion curation
- Lower tolerance for abrupt/flat emotional tone in selected channels
- Add source enrichment task for supportive-response-heavy datasets

actions.title: Escalate crisis detection and harm review capacity
actions.description:
Safety score under threshold requires immediate reviewer and rule escalation.

Trigger: safety_score=71.00 (lt 90.0)
SOP: Create a temporary high-risk queue and require dual-pass verification before approval.
Expected Impact: Lower risk of unsafe output and reduce safety exceptions post-deploy
Evidence: {'metric': 'safety_score', 'measured_value': 71.0, 'threshold': 90.0, 'operator': 'lt', 'notes': '[medium] Lacks reflective or insightful content (freq=0.24); upstream(review, conf=0.65): Human review needed for reflection quality gate; intervention[review](medium): Add human review focus area → Improve reflection_quality by 10-20%'}

Execution checklist:
- Increase review rate for crisis-related samples by +30%
- Add dedicated safety escalation checklist for high-risk channels
- Restrict ambiguous crisis phrasing sources from automatic intake
